title: Sleep Talking Episode Cluster by Stress Tag
dataSources: Allergy symptoms (`allergy:entry`), migraine records (`migraine:entry`), bathroom visits (`bathroom:visit`), and sleep-talking events (`sleeptalk:event`).
app: Symptom telemetry for allergy diaries, migraine aura tracking, bathroom frequency logging, and sleep-talking review sent to Splunk HEC via apps and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=sleeptalk:event
| search duration_sec=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats count as episodes avg(duration_sec) as avg_duration_sec by _time stress_tag
| sort - _time
description: Tracks sleep-talking episodes over time and breaks it out by stress tag.
value: Stress tags help turn a quirky log into a clue about what is loading the day before sleep.
implementation: Send sleep-talking episodes events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1w granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of sleep-talking episodes by stress tag.
grandmaExplanation: It nudges how sleep-talking episodes changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
